title: The supported finite boundary equation with shared concrete endpoints
statement: For l prime, Y with surface localizations, ordinary strict reduction D, strict H, derived endpoint/arrow data p for D.E(diagonalIntegralSource),H, ordinary supported-source cone s, Chern data c, restriction r, coefficients k, e:H≅r.F(lineModule(c)), models L0,L and n, finiteBoundaryEquation means supportedBoundaryEquation applied to the single of completedSupportedUnit, supportedSourceComparison(D,p,s,L0), p.arrow, coefficientRootTransport(p.target,e), and finiteChernComposite(c,r,k,L,n,diagonalPic(Y)). Thus it is exactly the displayed supported-class finite composite equal to the coefficient Chern composite. It is a real definition of an equation, with no new assertion or normalization hypothesis.

def finiteBoundaryEquation
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (D : DiagonalReductionPresentation l (diagonalScalarExtension l (diagonalSurface Y)))
    (H : DiagonalSystems l (diagonalSurface Y))
    (p : ExtDerivedPresentation (D.E.obj (diagonalIntegralSource Y)) H)
    (s : (diagonalCompletedRestriction l (diagonalSurface Y)).obj
        (diagonalCompletedSource l Y) ≅ limit (D.E.obj (diagonalIntegralSource Y)))
    (c : SpTowerClasses.Chern l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) (diagonalSurface Y))
    (r : Restriction l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) (diagonalSurface Y))
    (k : Coefficients l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) (diagonalSurface Y) c r)
    (e : H ≅ r.F.obj (SpTowerClasses.lineModule l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) c))
    (L₀ L : DiagonalRlim (DiagonalMod l (diagonalSurface Y))) (n : ℕ) : Prop
